title: Lentil chilli bake
summary: Lentil chilli bake is a mexican dinner built around canned green lentils and chopped tomatoes, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Lentil chilli bake into even pieces and toss chopped tomatoes with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of chopped tomatoes while you season canned green lentils. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle canned green lentils and red peppers among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Lentil chilli bake before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Lentil chilli bake into warm bowls with the juices.
